prompt: Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Use Spectrum 2-1: page #FAF9FB, text #2D1F2C, accent #861D24, secondary surface #EDEFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Junicode and reading text in Aileron; humanist reading serif with economical sans text. Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Use body 18px, heading 48px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 8px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
